resize: PIL bilinear resize to a fixed square; aspect ratio is not preserved

normalization.source: ImageNet constants for pretrained MobileNetV3; no statistics are estimated from validation/test

split.method: StratifiedGroupKFold; outer 5-fold test holdout, inner 4-fold validation from the remaining data
split.test_policy: Held-out test set is evaluated once after checkpoint/model selection; it is not used for tuning

augmentation.applies_to: training split only, on the fly after split assignment
augmentation.validation_test: deterministic resize, tensor conversion, ImageNet normalization only

raw_data_policy: Read-only. No raw images or metadata are rewritten. Split manifest and model inputs are stored separately.
duplicate_policy: Exact byte duplicates and patient/lesion identifiers are joined into one leakage group; conflicting duplicate labels block training.
